title: Rito Ra Vutlhari eMindzhutini
intro: Xifaniso xa le minkarhini ya khale, lexi tivekaka hi ku twisisa lokukulu, xi vulavula na wena eka malembe-xidzana lama hundzeke. Munhu loyi a nga kalanga a vula leswaku i muprofeta, hambiswiritano vutlhari bya Xikwembu a byi khuluka hi marito ya vona. Mutswari loyi a siyeke ndzhaka leyi nga heriki ya nkongomiso, switsundzuxo swa vona swi tshama swi hlayisiwile etimbilwini ta timiliyoni, swi hlayiwile ni ku anakanyisisiwa hi swona ku fikela namuntlha.
clues: Ndzi amukerile nyiko ya Xikwembu leyi ndzi hambaniseke - vutlhari lebyi dzikeke swinene byi hundzuke mfanelo ya mina leyi hlamuselaka eka matimu hinkwawo.
A ndzi nga ri murhumiwa kumbe ntsumi - moya-xiviri ntsena lowu katekisiweke hi ku twisisa loku dzikeke ni ku twisisa misava.
Vuxaka bya mina lebyikulu a ku ri ni n’wana wa mina, naswona hi ku tirhisa vuxaka lebyi, rungula ra mina leri nga heriki swinene ri yisiwe.
Ndzi hlohlotele ku nkhensa eka Loyi a ndzi nyikeke hinkwaswo, naswona ndzi tsundzuxe hi ku tikukumuxa ni ku tikukumuxa.
Ndzi dyondzise hi ntiko wa swiendlo leswi ringanaka hambi ku ri mbewu ya sinapi, ni nkoka wo hunguta rito ra munhu hi ku titsongahata.
Ndzima eka Quran yi rhwale vito ra mina, laha ndzayo ya mina eka n’wana wa mina la rhandzekaka yi hlayisiwaka hilaha ku nga heriki.

trial.label: Xikambelo/Xiendlakalo
options: Ku kamberiwa hi ku lehisa mbilu hi ku tirhisa mavabyi
Ku nyika vutlhari ni ku tsundzuxa n’wana wa munhu
Ku aka xibya lexikulu leswaku u balekela ndzoviso
trial.answer: Ku nyika vutlhari ni ku tsundzuxa n’wana wa munhu

location.label: Xiphemu xa Nkoka
options: Marito ya vutlhari lebyi nga hundzeriwiki hi nkarhi lama kongomisiweke eka n’wana wa munhu
location.answer: Marito ya vutlhari lebyi nga hundzeriwiki hi nkarhi lama kongomisiweke eka n’wana wa munhu

outcome.label: Mbuyelo
options: U nyikile vutlhari naswona u lerisile ku nkhensa eka Allah
U ve mufumi wa jinn, vanhu ni moya
U yisiwe ematilweni a ha hanya
Yi mitiwe hi whale leyikulu ivi yi huma yi pfuxetiwile
Lahleriwa exihlobyeni hi vamakwerhu lava nga ni mavondzo
outcome.answer: U nyikile vutlhari naswona u lerisile ku nkhensa eka Allah

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
